description: Frozen L1.5 observable-bridge models for G_birth on the canonical-engine DEV table, fit by OLS on DEV blocks/seeds 0-3 (all rows: phase==49 in full + seeded 20% sample of other phases, rng seed 12345). Bases copied UNCHANGED from the PU line's preregistration (f50_pu_bridge/w2/PREREG.json); this freeze is a coefficient refit only. Threshold fixed at 0 for all families (event_hat = F_hat > 0).

F1_LEGAL.formula_string: G_F1 = a0 + a1*yo + a2*yb + a3*sqrt(2*log(n))*sqrt(1-R**2) + a4*skew + a5*cob + a6*dmu

F2_AUG.role: augmented (uses PROPOSED_AUGMENTATION columns so, sb, rho)
F2_AUG.formula_string: G_F2 = a0 + a1*yo + a2*yb + a3*sqrt(2*log(n))*sqrt(1-R**2) + a4*skew + a5*cob + a6*dmu + a7*sqrt(2*log(n))*so + a8*sqrt(2*log(n))*sb + a9*rho

fit_method: ordinary least squares (numpy.linalg.lstsq), unconstrained, no regularization/hyperparameter search
evaluator: w2/bridge_eval.py: predict(family, table_dict) -> np.ndarray implements these equations exactly
note: F0_LOW is provided for completeness/reference; the task's frozen refit-on-all-seeds requirement targets F1_LEGAL (PRIMARY) and F2_AUG, both included above with full precision. rho's coefficient in F2_AUG is ~0 (numerically negligible), consistent with the near-zero rho coefficient seen on the PU line.
